notes.title: Dino Dash Party Monthly Updates!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Are you ready for a brand new game mode !? Stay alive and avoid various dangers in "Bomb Bomb Bomb" a frantic new game mode where you try to survive while throwing bombs at the "evil" spaceship!

[list]
[*] Bomb Bomb Bomb!
[/list]

Thank you for choosing to play with us.

Best regards,
Dino Dash Party Dev Team
